positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Build full stack web applications using React, Redux, React Native, Material UI, Node, Express, PostgreSQL, and Sequelize.
- Lead Frontend UI work and serve as Subject Matter Expert in User Experience .
- Converted existing state management to Redux and created higher-order reducers for scalability.
- In a week, ported a React Native app to React and completely reskinned it to match new designs.

positions.title: Senior Project Manager
positions.description:
Sales Enablement Teams

- Developed a Python + Flask web application to track projects and create / send weekly status email reports. Used across all US offices.
- Engineered a Python + Flask web application to track Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) progress.
- Managed cross-functional projects across multiple teams from the design to deployment stage.
- Partnered with Product Managers to define quarterly goals / OKRs, product roadmap, and user stories.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Invoicing & Product Billing Team

- Increased speed of internal promotion code creations by 80% after drafting an automated script.
- Developed a Python cron to take project data from JIRA and display progress on team's initiatives.

positions.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Job Search (Desktop & Mobile) and Resume Search teams

- Interviewed for all US offices and grew QA organization to 250 testers internationally.
- Trained and mentored test teams across multiple products and business areas, teaching product ownership, critical debugging skills, and accessibility.
- Organized and led testing of a tech stack migration from a monolithic system to Java microservices +
React frontend.
- Planned the test automation suite needed to achieve confidence for a team's move to CI/CD.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Job Search (Desktop & Mobile) teams

- Tested frontend applications, mobile apps, backend Java services, REST APIs, MySQL and Mongodb databases, server logging, and all of their interactions with each other.
- Defined product requirements, features, and testing infrastructure needed for products throughout the SDLC.
- Acted as Release Manager by merging in feature branches, investigating merge conflicts, deploying release candidates, and troubleshooting in production.

positions.title: QA Developer
positions.description:
R.J. Reynolds account

- Analyzed business requirements and functional specifications to draft and execute test plans and test cases.
- Manually tested web applications across all major browsers, operating systems, and mobile devices.
- Aided management in the implementation of a formal QA process including creating a new test plan template, test case format, and rolling out a new test case management software.
- Pinpointed requirement gaps and maintained site/brand consistency and legal compliance.
- Chosen to develop and present a legal and brand training document to 75+ team members due to proven knowledge of client and brand guidelines.
